message.content:
I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t give you an exact “now” quote.  
If you’re looking for the most recent price:

| Source | How to check |
|--------|--------------|
| **CoinGecko** (https://www.coingecko.com) | Search “Bitcoin”, view the ticker on the homepage. |
| **CoinMarketCap** (https://coinmarketcap.com) | Same – the BTC page shows the latest spot price. |
| **Crypto exchanges** (Binance, Coinbase Pro, Kraken, etc.) | Look under the BTC‑USD pair; most platforms update within seconds. |

For quick reference, as of my last training cut‑off (mid‑2025), Bitcoin was trading roughly between $30k–$35k USD per coin, though it’s highly volatile. If you need a precise figure right now, please consult one of those sites or your preferred exchange dashboard.
